title: The Light Between Oceans by M.L. Stedman
body: A lighthouse keeper and his wife face a moral dilemma when they find a baby adrift in a boat. A sweeping tale of isolation, love, and consequences.

title: The Lighthouse Keeper's Daughter by Hazel Gaynor
body: Spanning two timelines, this novel explores the lives of women connected by a lighthouse on the English coast.

title: The Lantern's Ember by Colleen Houck
body: A supernatural tale blending fantasy with coastal mystery. A lantern keeper discovers a hidden world.

title: Messages in a Bottle by Nicholas Sparks
body: A woman discovers a series of heartfelt letters washed ashore, leading her on a journey to find the author.

title: The Storied Life of A.J. Fikry
body: A tale of how unexpected connections transform a reclusive island bookshop owner's life.
